newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES EASIER BUT SPREAD NARROWER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES EASIER BUT SPREAD NARROWER.

text.p: HARARE, July 31 (Reuaer) - The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer on the U.S. dollar at the close of Thursday's interbank session but dealers said stability seemed to be returning to the market as evidenced by narrowing bid/offer spreads.
"We saw the central (Reserve) bank intervening today and it helped narrow the spreads a bit," one dealer said, adding:
"It was a very quiet day on the whole."

The dollar had gone on a free-fall during the past week triggered off by a large import payment last Wednesday and the pressure on the currency was further compounded on Friday by a central bank statement that the unit was overvalued.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 11.5700/6100 on the U.S. dollar after closing at 11.5500/6500 the previous day and was quoted at 18.9425/19.0195 versus sterling compared to 18.8700/19.0450.
It was at 6.3190/3390 from 6.2700/3260 against the mark but was firmer on the rand at 2.5110/5180 from 2.5475/5505.
